title: Humid 1.0: React server-side rendering in Rails can be easy!
partialText: We're releasing Humid 1.0. A few helper methods to help with React server-side rendering in Rails with mini_racer.

title: A prototype is not a product. It's a conversation.
partialText: Most organizations prototype too late. The best prototypes aren't built to validate software, they're built to create alignment. Especially in regulated industries, a prototype is the fastest way to replace assumptions with evidence and make better decisions.
